LOOK: Manila Mayor Francisco “Isko Moreno” Domagoso, joined by Vice Mayor Chi Atienza, presents a ₱14-billion list of flood control projects during a press conference at City Hall on Wednesday, August 27. He says that while most projects are reported as completed, many areas in the city still suffer from severe flooding during heavy rains. The list comes from the Office of the President’s “Isumbong sa Pangulo” website.

Meanwhile, the Manila City Government files charges against Jelsie Construction and Supply, Inc., represented by its general manager Jesse R. Mahusay, for the illegal demolition of the Rizal Avenue Sports Athletics Complex (RASAC) in Sta. Cruz.

📷: Mark Balmores | MB

PRESS BRIEFING. Manila Mayor Francisco “Isko Moreno” Domagoso discloses a roster of PHP14 billion worth of flood control projects in the city, during a press briefing at the City Hall on Wednesday (Aug. 27, 2025). 

He noted that while most of these projects were declared finished, many parts of the city still experience severe flooding during heavy downpour. The list was sourced from the Office of the President’s “Isumbong sa Pangulo” website.

Domagoso, meanwhile, said the city government is set to file criminal charges against the contractor behind the unauthorized demolition of the Rizal Avenue Sports Athletics Complex (RASAC) in Sta. Cruz district. (PNA photos by Yancy Lim)
